name: Orthosuchus
sum: Orthosuchus is a small Early Jurassic crocodyliform from the Elliot Formation of Lesotho and South Africa.
wsnote: No body-length estimate is given in the sources consulted.
holotype: Not stated in the sources consulted for this draft; first discovered in 1963 in the Red Beds of Qacha's Nek, Lesotho, and named by Nash in 1968.
material: Specimens from the Elliot Formation of Lesotho and South Africa, redescribed by Dollman et al. in 2021.
biology: Ear flaps probably kept water out of the otic recess when it was in the water; the head was flattened.
author: Nash 1968
